# AgentScope Java

> AgentScope Java 2.0 is a production-ready Java framework (JDK 17+) for building distributed,
> enterprise-grade LLM agents. `ReActAgent` provides the reasoning-acting core; `HarnessAgent`
> layers on workspace, layered memory, session persistence, subagents, sandboxes, permissions,
> and a typed event stream for building long-running agents that operate safely in production.

Key modules:
- `agentscope-core` — bare `ReActAgent`, messages/events, tools, permission system, model registry
- `agentscope-harness` — `HarnessAgent`: workspace, memory, session state, subagents, middleware
- `agentscope-extensions-model-*` — model provider integrations (DashScope, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama)
- `agentscope-service` — Agent Control Plane / Dashboard for fleet-wide observability and orchestration
- `agentscope-examples` — runnable example projects for every core feature

- [FAQ](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/others/faq.md): common setup and usage questions

- [Release Notes](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/others/release-notes.md): per-version changes

## Building Blocks

- [Agent](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/agent.md): `ReActAgent` builder API, `call` / `streamEvents` / `observe`, HITL
- [Model](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/model.md): `ModelRegistry`, provider string ids, API-key env vars, custom model builders
- [Tool](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/tool.md): `@Tool` / `@ToolParam`, registering tools on a `Toolkit`, parameter schema generation (generics, `required`, `$defs`), `ToolBase`, tool groups
- [Message and Event](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/message-and-event.md): `ContentBlock`, `Msg`, the 31 typed events, structured output
- [Permission System](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/permission-system.md): `PermissionMode`, `PermissionContextState`, allow/ask/deny rules, HITL approval
- [Middleware](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/middleware.md): `onAgent` / `onReasoning` / `onActing` / `onModelCall` / `onSystemPrompt` hooks
- [Context](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/building-blocks/context.md): `RuntimeContext`, `sessionId` / `userId`, per-call state

## Harness (HarnessAgent)

- [Harness Architecture](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/architecture.md): how `HarnessAgent` composes workspace/memory/subagents on top of `ReActAgent`
- [Configuration](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/configuration.md): complete `HarnessAgent.builder()` reference — identity, model, tools, workspace, filesystem, state, subagents, skills, plan mode, and every switch that disables a built-in
- [Workspace](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/workspace.md): `AGENTS.md` / `MEMORY.md` / `skills/` / `subagents/` / `tools.json` layout
- [Memory](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/memory.md): layered memory, `MEMORY.md`, on-disk fact log
- [Subagent](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/subagent.md): `SubagentDeclaration`, `agent_spawn` / `agent_send`, sync vs. background delegation
- [Sandbox](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/sandbox.md): local / Docker / Kubernetes / cloud sandbox tool execution
- [Filesystem](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/filesystem.md): local, shared-store, and sandbox deployment modes
- [Skill](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/skill.md): self-evolving Markdown skill repository
- [Plan Mode](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/plan-mode.md): read-only planning state for long-running tasks
- [Compaction](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/compaction.md): auto context compaction and offloading
- [Channel](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/docs/harness/channel.md): IM channel integration (DingTalk, Feishu, WeCom)

## Integrations

- [Model Providers Overview](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/model/index.md): DashScope, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax
- [Distributed Deployment](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/distributed/index.md): Redis / MySQL / OSS backends for horizontal scaling
- [Session Persistence](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/session/index.md): `AgentStateStore` implementations (JSON file, MySQL, Redis, PostgreSQL, OSS)
- [RAG](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/rag/index.md): Bailian, Dify, Haystack, RAGFlow integrations
- [Protocols](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/protocol/index.md): A2A, AG-UI, Agent Protocol
- [Skill Repositories](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/skill/index.md): Git / MySQL / PostgreSQL-backed skill storage
- [Infrastructure](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope-java/blob/main/docs/v2/en/integration/infrastructure/index.md): Nacos, Higress, Scheduler
